goal: Separate DC-Agent organization facts, external platform facts, and DC runtime permissions so Feishu admins, department managers, bosses, app bots, and global DC admins are not conflated.

target_architecture.organization_root: 广西巅池文化传媒有限公司

acceptance_criteria.description: Department names are normalized to the Feishu organization tree while keeping business scope distinct from raw Feishu leaf departments.
A Feishu app admin fact is preserved as external platform identity but does not grant DC global admin permission.
Bosses and department managers receive scoped organization permissions for managed departments without becoming DC global admins.
Existing admins_id entries still become DC global admins, and app bot identifiers are treated as app principals rather than human staff.

Every inbound runtime event resolves one subject-bound Runtime Principal before Router execution and publishes complete permission records with subject_id, subject_type, permission, scope, source, and enabled state.
Runtime Principal resolution still evaluates explicit admins_id and persisted DC assignments when an employee profile is missing, while an unknown sender without assignments remains non-admin.

Authorization Decision is centralized and rejects permission records bound to another subject, app principals carrying user authority, disabled assignments, and department-scoped authority used as global authority.
Runtime approval gates consume the centralized Authorization Decision instead of accepting permission strings from plugin-local lists.
Harness task-producing adapters reuse the Runtime Principal resolver instead of rebuilding partial requester identity from employee_store.
Feishu employee batch sync first returns a deterministic read-only Identity Sync Control Plan with plan_id, projected additions, blank-field updates, conflicts, and remaining review count.
Default batch apply requires the exact current plan_id, matches only by open_id, fills blank identity fields, preserves non-empty local values, and never changes DC permission assignments.

The employee command defaults to preview, scheduled sync defaults to preview-only, and explicit apply uses /employees sync apply <plan_id>; completed profile changes are visible to Runtime Principal resolution on the next event.

A missing role may be proposed from the governed organization roster only when the existing open_id record, exact Feishu name, exact local name, and exact department agree; otherwise the employee remains in manual review.
